authority: Backend is the sole authority for payment state, wallet balance, ledger posting, refunds, earnings, cash collection, commission and settlement. Clients render backend results and never determine transaction success.

Payment.purpose: One authoritative payment record per booking (schema currently declares bookingId unique).

PaymentAttempt.purpose: Provider/method-specific attempt record; ambiguous results are not assumed failed/successful.

Refund.purpose: Refund request and provider processing record; idempotency key is unique when present.

WalletTransaction.purpose: Wallet ledger-like operation record; referenceId is unique when present.

DriverEarning.purpose: Gross fare, commission and net earning record.

CashCollection.purpose: Driver cash collection evidence with verified flag.

CommissionEntry.purpose: Commission calculation record; rate precision is Decimal(6,4).

IdempotencyKey.purpose: Request idempotency record; actual key scope/retention policy requires review.

Booking.purpose: Source business transaction holding estimatedFare/finalFare and payment preference/status relationship.

invariantsToApproveAndVerify: A provider/client callback cannot mark payment successful until backend verifies its authenticity, booking, amount, currency and current attempt state.
No duplicate provider callback, API retry or repeated Gateway/event may double-post a payment, refund, wallet transaction, commission, earning or settlement.
Unknown/timeout payment outcomes require reconciliation; they must not be blindly retried as new payments or treated as success.
Ledger postings must be balanced according to an approved accounting model; exact account sides and posting order require finance approval.
Wallet balance changes and WalletTransaction/LedgerEntry writes must be atomic and use idempotency.
Refund total may not exceed the captured/eligible amount, subject to an approved refund policy.
Driver net earning, commission, cash collection and settlement must reconcile to the applicable final booking fare and approved commission rules.
Negative amount handling, precision/rounding, currency rules, taxes, fees, payout reversals and partial refunds require explicit policy and test vectors.
Privileged financial adjustments need server-side permission, reason, actor attribution and immutable audit evidence.
statusNote: This is a static model/state catalogue, not approval of current money formulas or a complete accounting transition graph. Physical financial tests remain deferred until all four baseline packages are implemented.

auditEvidence.payoutChecks: raw-body signature, terminal status transition handling, uncertain-outcome reconciliation, idempotency, amount reconciliation
